messages:
Priya K: Hey team — prepping my first PR to add a tiny metric in the inference runtime. Quick q: recommended target branch, branch-name pattern, and who should I ping for review? Also what's the minimal local test checklist to avoid noisy CI failures?

Riley: target `main` for any production changes. For multi-week features you can open a draft PR but still branch off `main`. Branch naming we use: `feature/TEAM-1234-short-desc` or `fix/TEAM-1234-brief`. e.g. `feature/ENG-842-kv-cache-logging`.

Sam: local sanity: run `./scripts/test.sh unit` then `make lint`. CI runs the heavy GPU/integration suites so you don't need to run them locally unless you're changing runtime kernels. Quick commands: `./scripts/test.sh unit && make lint` or `pytest tests/ -k fast` for a focused run.

Olivia: reviewers: check `CODEOWNERS` first (it auto-suggests), but for runtime changes explicitly add @Olivia and @Sam. If you touch docs/ or onboarding snippets, add @Mira. Mention the release-impact in the PR description (canary/beta note).

Mira: small checklist I ask for in reviews: 1) short PR description + motivating example, 2) list of affected endpoints/config keys, 3) what to watch in staging (latency/cpu), 4) tests added or why not. Add `release-note: none` or appropriate label.

Priya K: thanks! One more — merge strategy? squash or merge-commit?

Riley: squash + conventional commits preferred. Keep the final commit message as `type(scope): short description` (we use `feat(runtime): add kv-cache metric`). Put details in the body. If you need to preserve history for a large feature, discuss on the PR.

Sam: also, CI will reject if lint errors or `flake8` fails. If you hit a flaky test flagged by CI, tag @ci-bot and paste the failing test ID. ci-bot will post the re-run command.

ci-bot: fyi — to re-run the unit matrix: click "Re-run jobs" in GH Actions or run `./scripts/ci_local_retry.sh <job>` locally for quick repro.

Mira: example PR body template we like to use (feel free to copy):
```
Summary: one-line summary
Why: short motivation
Changes: bullet list of changes
Tests: what was run locally and in CI
Rollout: canary steps / when to monitor
```

Priya K: awesome — this is super helpful. I'll branch as `feature/ENG-274-add-kv-metric`, run unit + lint, add the checklist, and ping @Olivia + @Sam. Thanks all :party-parrot:

Riley: welcome aboard! ping in thread if you need a quick review slot — happy to take a look during async hours. :thumbsup:
